ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: In the diagram, which is a predator?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: This is a schematic diagram of a food web, containing many labeled organisms, such as cougar, Spotted owl, Red tree vole, Winter wren, Flying squirrel, Mountain beaver, Douglas fir tree needles, etc. Near the upper middle of the image there is a bird, with the label written as “Spotted owl”. There are arrows pointing from near smaller animals to this spotted owl, for example connected to it from the direction of animals such as red tree vole, winter wren, etc. Reasoning: In a food web, arrows usually indicate that energy flows from the organism being eaten to the organism that eats it, so other animals pointing to spotted owl indicates that spotted owl will prey on these animals. The question asks which one in the image is a predator, so the answer is owl.
